title: feat(console): the approvals queue steps from request to request and opens the next one after a decision
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBBEmBB4ANuFvWucqJiUu2cu)_

Fixes #34586

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new export, `approvalQueueState`, from `@object-ui/app-shell` (workspace-private: `"private": true`, not published; the console is its one consumer), and two new `approvalsInbox` keys in the `@object-ui/i18n` locale packs (`openNextAfterDecision`, `queueDone`; `TranslationKeys` grows); nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：从「待我审批」打开一条请求时，把当前筛选和排序下的待审列表一起带过去；请求页右上角出现计数（「1 / 3」，读屏和悬停提示为「第 1 条，共 3 条」）、上一条 / 下一条和 J / K，面包屑能回到收件箱；新增「处理后打开下一条」开关（默认开，按浏览器记住），通过、驳回、退回、转交等让请求离开「我的待审」之后自动打开下一条，最后一条处理完回到列表并提示已处理完。
- 为什么改：维护者 11-17 走查：「审批页通常要看完整记录，如何让操作更方便」；原来处理完一条要自己回列表再点下一条。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台前端（收件箱打开请求的方式、请求页顶栏加一个开关、一处已有导航函数抽出复用），不动审批权限、规则和服务端接口；从通知、直接链接、「我提交的」「全部」打开的请求不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/approvalQueueAdvance.tsx`（何时自动前进：请求在本页重新读取后状态离开 pending 或 `viewer.can_act` 变 false）、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` 的 `openRequest`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 两处顶栏 `toggles`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.queueStepper-34586.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/approvalQueueAdvance-34586.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件 17 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The queue travels with the request.** The inbox's `openRequest` now navigates, from the pending tab only, with `approvalQueueState({ pathname, label }, filteredRows ids)`: the `from` shape every list hands a record page it opens (`from.pathname`, `from.label`, `from.siblings`) plus one marker key, `approvalQueue: true`. The rows are `filteredRows`, the list exactly as it is drawn (search, process, object and status filters, and the sort). The "Submitted by me" and "All" tabs list requests the reader is not deciding, so they hand no queue.

**The counter and next / previous are the record page's own.** `RecordDetailView` already draws the counter, ↓ ↑ and `j` / `k` over `from.siblings` (`useRecordPageReturn` in `recordDrawerStack.tsx`), and its crumb already returns to `from.pathname` by `from.label`. Nothing new draws them; the inbox now feeds them. The visible face is the house counter `1 / 3`; the accessible name and tooltip are `detail.recordOfScope` (`1 of 3 in Approvals Inbox`; zh-CN 「第 1 条，共 3 条」 is `detail.recordOf`).

**Open next after deciding** (`approval-decision/approvalQueueAdvance.tsx`, new). `useApprovalQueueAdvance(requestId, row)` runs on a `sys_approval_request` page (not in a pane) and watches the row the page shows. When the same request goes from "in the reader's queue" (`status: 'pending'` and `viewer.can_act` true; status alone when the row has no `viewer`) to out of it, and the switch is on, it replaces the page with the next request (the one after it, else the one before it) and drops the decided id from `from.siblings`, so the counter reads `1 of 2`. With none left it replaces the page with the list and toasts `approvalsInbox.queueDone`. The change is observed on the page's own re-read: `ApprovalDecisionPanel` already announces the request changed after a declared action succeeds (`notifyDataChanged`), and the page re-reads it through `ApprovalRecordReads`. So an action that leaves the request waiting on the reader (request info, remind) moves nothing, and a request first shown already decided moves nothing.

The switch, 「处理后打开下一条」, is drawn in the page's top bar after the counter, on the desktop and the phone bar, only on a page opened from the queue. Its value is a reader preference in the console's one preference store: `APPROVAL_QUEUE_OPEN_NEXT_PREFERENCE` (`workspacePreference.ts`, `user` scope, on / off, default on, per browser, never metadata).

**Small reuse edits.** `recordDrawerStack.tsx` exports `readFromSiblings` (unchanged) and a new `siblingRecordStep(location, fromId, toId)`: the route, search and state the counter's ↓ ↑ already computed inline, extracted so the queue's step lands exactly where ↓ would. The counter's own `go` now calls it; behaviour is unchanged. `@object-ui/app-shell` exports `approvalQueueState`.

**Strings.** `approvalsInbox.openNextAfterDecision` and `approvalsInbox.queueDone` in all 11 locales of `@object-ui/i18n` (the key-parity test needs all of them).

**File surface.** One changed file sits outside claim 6936650853's list: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` (+3 lines, the `approvalQueueState` export the console imports); the seat's claim amendment adds it.

Not changed: approval permissions, rules and server endpoints; the decision bar's buttons (card #34361 owns their layout); the inbox's list rendering.

## Tests

New files, named for the card:

- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.queueStepper-34586.test.tsx` (6 tests) mounts the real inbox and the real `RecordDetailView` under `ApprovalRecordReads`, as the #12484 harness does. Acceptance 1 (first of three opens as `1 of 3 in Approvals Inbox`, the crumb names the inbox, ↓ opens the second as `2 of 3`), the set follows a search, acceptance 2 (approve the first, land on the second as `1 of 2`; reject it, land on the third; approve the last, back on the inbox with the done toast), acceptance 3 (switch off, the page stays), acceptance 4 (direct link: no counter, no switch, a decision moves nothing), and a control that the "All" tab hands no queue. A decision is simulated as the panel's own after-decision step: the served row changes and `notifyDataChanged` announces it.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/approvalQueueAdvance-34586.test.tsx` (11 tests): the state reader (a list's unmarked `from` is not the queue), `nextInQueue`, `inReaderQueue`, and the hook over a route: advance with the set shrunk, countersign (`can_act` false while still `pending`) advances, the last goes to the list with the toast, switch off stays and is kept for the next page, turning it back on after a decision moves nothing, request-info stays, an already-decided request stays, no queue state draws nothing.

Runs, from `ui/`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (shared box):

- the two new files: console `Tests 6 passed (6)` on `36749a16` (the file is unchanged since), app-shell `Tests 11 passed (11)` on `885cedbf`;
- the affected set, 115 files that read the record top bar, `useRecordPageReturn`, `recordDrawerStack`, `workspacePreference` or the inbox and decision panel, plus all of `packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 214 passed | 2 failed | 1 skipped (217)` on `36749a16`. Both reds were this branch's own and are fixed on `885cedbf`: `zh-Hant.ts` is generated from `zh-Hans.ts` (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant`, one word changed), and one new pin of mine asserted the wrong stored value. Re-run of those files plus the key-parity test: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 70 passed (70)`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

1. Inbox hands no queue (`tab === 'pending'` replaced by `false` in `openRequest`): console file `4 failed | 2 passed`; the two greens are acceptance 4 and the All-tab control, which pin the absence.
2. Switch ignored (`!openNext` dropped from the advance guard): `2 failed | 14 passed` across both files (the two switch-off pins).
3. "Was in the queue" dropped (`!before.queued` removed): app-shell `1 failed | 10 passed` (turning the switch back on after a decision it was off for moved the page).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card asks for 「第 N 条，共 M 条」 on the page. The visible counter is the record page's house face `N / M` on every list-opened page; the sentence form is its accessible name and tooltip. Changing the visible face would change every record page, so it stays.
- Each request opens under the app that owns its record (`requestPagePath`, objectstack#32667). Stepping keeps the app segment of the page it steps from, as the counter's ↓ does on any list.
- When the reader decides the last request after skipping earlier ones with ↓, the page opens the one before it rather than returning to the list; the list is "done" only when the set is empty.
- "Remembered per user" is the console's per-reader preference store, which is per browser (as every other reader preference in `workspacePreference.ts`), not a server-side setting: the order asks for a client-side preference only.

## Verification

- Type check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/console`: all exit 0.
- Lint: `npx eslint` on every changed file from its package directory: 0 errors. New warnings: two `react-refresh/only-export-components` for the two new non-component exports of `recordDrawerStack.tsx` (the file already exports 14 such). A `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` the extraction first added is fixed in `dbe3c289`; no other warning is on a changed line.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 41; all 41 exit 0, plus `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` (roster under `.changeset/`) exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation `41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. That sweep ran from `36749a16` while three later commits (a test split, the zh-Hant regeneration, the Clause-② line) landed; the three changeset gates were re-run on `4288d50e` (exit 0 each). After the lint fix (`dbe3c289`, behaviour-identical; the counter and queue pins re-run green: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 54 passed (54)`) the full union is re-running on that head, and its reading is in the os-dev-report comment on the card.
- Merged `origin/main` (`082f9c294`, with #34621 for sibling card #34587 on the same `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`) cleanly as `afe198ed0`. On it: the inbox, approval-decision, `recordDrawerStack` and all `packages/i18n` tests `Test Files 127 passed (127)`, `Tests 2079 passed | 13 skipped`; type-check console and app-shell exit 0; the four base-relative gates exit 0 each.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` before every push: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (shared locale files with #34539, #34531 and #34333 merge cleanly; #34587 has no PR yet).
- Not measured locally, left to CI: the type-check program lanes (`Type Check UI` and the workspace typecheck), the full UI suite, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`. No dogfood battery: the title has no `!` and Clause-② has no `(narrowing)` arm.
